title: 1RB1LF_1LC1RB_1LF1LD_1LE0RD_1LB---_1LA0LA: the factory rule, 11 hits make one rung
text: Behind each ×64 eater sits a factory: run with symbolic counts from all 11 states of its cycle, 11 hits add one rung to the next fuel, burn 6 units of its fuel [100]M and pass 2 hits further down. Law A follows, proved in Lean from the rule (lean/Factory.lean). The word below the eater does not grow (about 300 long runs at the start and after 14,000 phases).
